narrative.overview: The page is a darkened screening room. Photography and real product screens are the only light source; the interface is the slate and the caption beneath them. Depth is flat and photography-lit, with hairlines and tonal layers instead of shadow. Arabic is a first-class voice.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black field with cream and soft-white type; one cool blue held in reserve.
Instrument Serif for display, tracked mono caps for captions.
Hairline borders at 10% white; tonal layering instead of shadow.
Small 3-4px corners; no pills or rounded cards.
Real unretouched screenshots as evidence; generated art disclosed.

rules.name: The Light Is Photography Rule
rules.body: Chromatic color belongs to imagery. UI never adds a hue to look branded.

rules.name: The 4.5 Floor Rule
rules.body: Text on night black never falls below 4.5:1.

rules.name: The No-Tracking-In-Arabic Rule
rules.body: Any letter-spacing breaks Arabic joins; RTL text sets tracking to 0.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px line or a tonal step.

dos: Do let photography and real screenshots carry color; keep UI cream, soft white and slate.
Do use 1px white/10 hairlines and tonal layers for separation.
Do keep every nonessential loop paused when offscreen and removed under reduced motion.
Do give every control a 44px hit area and a cream focus ring.
Do mirror layout and flip arrows in Arabic, with no letter-spacing.
donts: Don't add gradients on text, glow shadows, glass blur, or colored side borders.
Don't put rounded cards, pills or icon-grid card rows on the page.
Don't put text under 11px or below 4.5:1 contrast.
Don't retouch or mock up real screenshots; disclose generated art with the art note.
Don't repeat one scroll-reveal on every section; motion is authored moments, not a default.
